tagline: Merge PDFs into one or split a PDF by page ranges in your browser
pageDescription: Combine multiple PDF files into a single document, or split a PDF into separate files and individual pages by page range — all without installing any software. This free online PDF Merger & Splitter runs locally in your browser, so your files are never uploaded to a server and confidential documents stay private. It merges PDFs without losing quality and extracts specific chapters, sections, or single pages in seconds. A fast, private alternative to iLovePDF and Smallpdf, with no signup, no watermarks, and no file-size paywall.

instructions.title: How to merge or split PDF files

steps.title: Choose merge or split
steps.description: Use the tab to pick Merge PDFs (combine files) or Split PDF (extract page ranges).

steps.title: Upload your PDFs
steps.description: Drag and drop your PDF files onto the upload area, or click to browse. For merging, add two or more files; for splitting, add one.

steps.title: Order or set ranges
steps.description: When merging, reorder files with the up/down arrows so pages appear in the right sequence. When splitting, type page ranges like '1-3, 5, 8-10'.

steps.title: Run the operation
steps.description: Click Merge PDFs or Split PDF. Processing happens instantly in your browser — nothing is uploaded.

steps.title: Download the result
steps.description: Download the merged PDF, or download each split part individually or all at once.

troubleshooting: Merge button disabled: add at least two PDF files
Invalid range error: use numbers, commas and hyphens only, e.g. '1-3, 5'
Page out of range: ranges must stay within the document's page count
Nothing happens on upload: make sure the file is a real PDF, not renamed
Encrypted PDF issues: password-protected files may fail to load
